meta.title: Turn Sieve (dsh-turn-sieve)
meta.description: Selectively drop a whole exchange, only your prompt, only the assistant reply, or a single message from the current conversation. Every chat row can be sieved in place: the assistant action row on the right, and a button that floats in from the left of your own messages. One click selects that part — it instantly gets a deeper background with rounded shadow corners — then confirm with ✓, cancel with ✕, and switch between “Exchange / Prompt / Reply / Only this”. No dialog at all. Stopped and failed turns can be sieved too; only while the agent is still running is the newest exchange locked. Once removed, the part disappears from the transcript immediately (the append-only log stays intact) and can be restored with one undo from the main panel. The main panel uses a bright liquid-glass look with “Liquid glass / Motion” toggles in its header. The system context and the initial session context stay protected.
